-- creating database in serverless SQL pool

CREATE DATABASE sales_db;

-- creating view for accounts data from silver layer data

USE sales_db;

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_accounts AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://sapawandev.dfs.core.windows.net/crm-sales-data/silver/accounts.csv/**',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS result


-- creating view for data_dictionary data from silver layer data

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_data_dictionary AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://sapawandev.dfs.core.windows.net/crm-sales-data/silver/data_dictionary.csv/**',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    FIELDTERMINATOR = ',',
    FIELDQUOTE = '',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS result

-- creating view for products data from silver layer data

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_products AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://sapawandev.dfs.core.windows.net/crm-sales-data/silver/products.csv/**',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS result

-- creating view for sales_pipeline data from silver layer data

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_sales_pipeline AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://sapawandev.dfs.core.windows.net/crm-sales-data/silver/sales_pipeline.csv/**',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS result

-- creating view for sales_teams data from silver layer data

CREATE VIEW dbo.vw_sales_teams AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(

    FORMAT = 'CSV',

    HEADER_ROW = TRUE
) AS result
